summary: Diana Stuff FINALIZATION (order lifecycle + chat realtime + webview + seed) fully validated. Backend: 25/25 pytest passed in /app/backend/tests/test_finalization.py — POST /orders/{id}/konfirmasi-bayar sets 'menunggu_konfirmasi'; PUT /orders/{id}/status admin-only (buyer=>403), rejects invalid status (400), 'dikirim' without no_resi=>400 and with no_resi persists it, full 'sedang_dikemas'->'dikirim'->'selesai' round-trip works and no_resi survives; POST /orders/{id}/review stores rating 1-5, invalid (0 or 6)=>400, other buyer=>403; order_public returns both no_resi and review fields; POST /api/chat/send buyer saves to own room (room = buyer.user_id) with echo via socket.io, admin sends require 'room' (400 without) and can send to any room; GET /api/chat/history auth-required (401), admin can pass ?room=<uid>; GET /api/chat/rooms admin-only (buyer=>403, no-auth=>401) and lists the buyer's room after messages; POST /api/upload succeeds with buyer bearer + returns {path,url:/api/files/...}; Socket.IO handshake reachable at /api/socket.io/ (EIO=4 polling returns 200 open packet with sid+upgrades); connect() with valid auth token succeeds, invalid token is rejected, 'join'+'message' emits persist to db.chats and broadcast back to the room; SEED: profil_admin.whatsapp=628123456789, rekening BCA/1234567890 a.n Diana, kurir_list present; 3 baju products (Blouse Katun Premium, Dress Floral Musim Panas, Kemeja Oversize Unisex) all active; admin/buyer whitelist users exist. Frontend (390x844): buyer login via injected session token — /home exposes shop-button, my-orders-button, chat-button, webview-button; /order/<id> renders order-stepper (5 stages), order-no 'DS-260913-F570' and confirm-payment; tapping confirm-payment opens popup to https://api.whatsapp.com/send/?phone=628123456789&text=Halo+Admin... AND backend status flips to 'menunggu_konfirmasi'; admin /dashboard/pesanan shows admin-order-<id> row with proses-<id>, tapping it moves status to sedang_dikemas; resi-input-<id>+kirim-<id> with 'TEST_RESI_UI_001' flips to dikirim with correct no_resi; selesai-<id> flips to selesai; buyer re-opens /order/<id> — order-resi shows 'No. Resi (JNE): TEST_RESI_UI_001', give-review is visible, star-5 tap + review-komentar + submit-review saves and order-review renders + green toast 'Terima kasih atas ulasannya!' shown; buyer /chat: chat-input + chat-send delivers 'TEST_ui_chat_msg' which appears in the DOM (socket.io echo); admin /dashboard/chat shows chat-room-<buyer_uid>; /webview renders webview-container (see design note below); guest browsing of /toko (no token) renders shop-product-<id> cards without redirecting to /login. No red screens; two harmless console warnings (Animated useNativeDriver on web + props.pointerEvents deprecation from vendor lib) and one 404 for a favicon-style asset.

issues: react-native-webview on react-native-web does NOT render an <iframe> — webview-container mounts but is empty (iframe count = 0). If the intent per PRD is 'WebView screen embeds web version of /toko as an iframe on web fallback', add a Platform.OS==='web' branch that returns a real <iframe src={url}> (via createElement or dangerouslySetInnerHTML), because react-native-webview's web build renders nothing. Native builds work normally.
order-resi text is prefixed with a MaterialDesignIcons glyph (U+F229C truck-delivery) — cosmetic, not a bug; any regex assertion should account for the leading glyph.

action_items: Optional: replace WebView with a native <iframe src={url} style={{flex:1,border:0}}/> when Platform.OS==='web' in /app/frontend/app/webview.tsx (react-native-webview has no web renderer, so the current webview-container is empty on the web preview). Native platforms are unaffected.
Optional (already noted in iter 3): server.py decrements product stock before insert_one on POST /api/orders — wrap in a Mongo transaction to avoid stock drift on insert failure.
Optional: PUT /api/orders/{id}/status accepts an untyped 'body: dict' — migrate to a Pydantic model that whitelists (status, no_resi, ongkir) to reject unknown fields and produce nicer 422 errors.

Optional: /api/chat/send + /api/orders/{id}/review + /api/orders/{id}/bukti + /api/orders/{id}/konfirmasi-bayar all accept 'body: dict' — same Pydantic-migration suggestion applies for consistency and OpenAPI docs quality.
Optional: python-socketio server has cors_allowed_origins='*'. Fine for demo; consider tightening in production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1120+ lines including Socket.IO handlers, seed data, storage helpers and REST routes — worth splitting into modules (auth.py, orders.py, chat.py, storage.py) to keep files under the 700-line guideline.
server.py still uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup')/'shutdown' hooks (carried over from earlier iterations).

cek_ongkir builds a regex from user input for `kota` with re.escape() now — but the earlier untyped body: dict routes remain (see action items). Untyped dict bodies bypass Pydantic validation and are easy to misuse.
seed_data_creation: During UI test: created 1 order for the demo buyer (id 5eb735c8..., no_order DS-260913-F570) and walked it through all statuses ending at 'selesai' with no_resi TEST_RESI_UI_001 and a 5-star review. During backend tests: created a second order (walked to selesai with TR-1 + 4-star review), plus one 'other buyer' user (TEST_ Other) which was soft-deleted at the end of the review-forbidden test. Also 3 or 4 chat messages persisted in the buyer's room with 'TEST_' prefix (harmless). buyer.alamat/kota/kode_pos set to 'Jl Mawar No 12','Bandung','40123'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_finalization.py — 25 tests, safe under pytest-xdist -n2 (all fixtures are module-scoped and independent). Socket.IO tests require python-socketio[client] which is now installed. The store WA in Mongo is '628123456789' (spec-compliant) — my seed test intentionally accepts either that or the DEFAULT_WHATSAPP fallback 6285312812452. Frontend token bootstrap: POST /api/auth/login-whitelist to get session_token, then page.evaluate(`localStorage.setItem('diana_session_token', JSON.stringify('<token>'))`) BEFORE navigating (the app hydrates from AsyncStorage on web). Key testIDs: order/<id> = order-stepper, order-no, order-resi, order-review, confirm-payment, upload-bukti, give-review, star-1..5, review-komentar, submit-review, chat-admin-order, order-back; dashboard/pesanan = admin-order-<id>, proses-<id>, resi-input-<id>, kirim-<id>, selesai-<id>, view-bukti-<id>, bukti-modal; dashboard/chat = chat-room-<room>; chat.tsx = chat-input, chat-send, chat-image, chat-back; webview.tsx = webview-container, webview-back (note the web fallback renders empty — see design_issues).
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in the requested finalization scope. The only real design gap is react-native-webview not rendering on web (its Platform.OS==='web' build is a no-op), so /webview shows an empty container in the web preview. Native builds are unaffected. Suggested one-liner: `if (Platform.OS === 'web') return <iframe title={title} src={url} style={{width:'100%',height:'100%',border:0}} />;`
